channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Scott Perry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Scott Perry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Domantas Sabonis on Scott Perry
item.description:
Domantas Sabonis:

“I can’t control any of it. The injury helped. I was just focused on getting healthy. A lot of things are being said out there, but I have a great relationship with Scott [Perry]. I have great agents. I know everything that’s going on. And I’m excited I’m here,”

Domantas Sabonis on Scott Perry, Oct 2, 2026. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Marc Spears on Scott Perry, Jalen Duren
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Marc Spears on Jalen Duren and Sacramento:

“Scott Perry has a relationship with Jalen Duren dating to when he was trying to get the Knicks to draft him which they did, but they traded him to the Pistons... Duren likes Scott Perry a lot, he likes Sacramento a lot, but the Pistons, they're focused on bringing him back, they have some optimism, but it's complicated. I just hear that Jalen, it's not about money right now. He feels disrespected...there's a black cloud going into camp...they gotta try to fix it, and I don't know if they can in time”

Marc Spears on Scott Perry, Jalen Duren, Sep 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Vivek Ranadive on Scott Perry
item.description:
Vivek Ranadivé on hiring Scott Perry as GM of the Sacramento Kings:

“Scott brings a wealth of experience, a sharp basketball mind, & a strong track record of building talented rosters. He shares our commitment to developing and sustaining a winning culture & I am excited to welcome him back to Sacramento.”

Vivek Ranadive on Scott Perry, Apr 21, 2025. Source: Twitter @SeanCunningham.

item.title: David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills
item.description:
Statement from David Fizdale:

“Coaching the New York Knicks has been a great honor and I appreciate Steve Mills, Scott Perry and Jim Dolan for providing me with this opportunity. There are lessons we take with us from every life experience and I am especially grateful for the lessons I have learned from the extraordinary group of people within the MSG family - from the players, coaches, development staff, and trainers to the arena crew, concession workers and ushers - who have all treated me and my family so well during our time with the team.”

David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Dec 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Steve Mills on Scott Perry, David Fizdale
item.description:
“We laid out a plan when (GM) Scott (Perry) came on board and then (coach) David (Fizdale) joined us that we were going to build this team the right way,”

Steve Mills on Scott Perry, David Fizdale, Jun 21, 2019. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills
item.description:
David Fizdale:

“Scott Perry and Steve Mills have done a heck of a job laying this thing out. We’ve got the most cap space. We have seven picks over five years, which means whoever we do get, we can continue to build around them, and I think that’s a great position to be in. We did all that in a course of a year and we laid down our culture, so I’m really excited about where we’re at.”

David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Apr 22, 2019. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on Mark Bartelstein, Scott Perry
item.description:
“And I would let [Knicks general manager] Scott [Perry] and my agent [Mark Bartelstein] handle that stuff.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on Mark Bartelstein, Scott Perry, Jan 21, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: David Fizdale on Scott Perry
item.description:
David Fizdale:

“Scott (Perry) and these guys are big-time sticking to an awesome plan of bringing in guys that maybe didn’t work out at a place where they were at before but are high draft picks. Under some good player development and some culture, maybe they can turn into something close to what they were expected to be ... We’re doing it the right way.”

David Fizdale on Scott Perry, Aug 23, 2018. Source: The Score.

item.title: Adam Silver on James Dolan, Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Mark Jackson
item.description:
Stephen A Smith to Adam Silver on supporting Mark Jackson bc Knicks need a spokesperson:

“I like Steve Mills & Scott Perry but they need a voice that speaks to the media every day & it can't be one of the players & we both know it'll never be James Dolan.”

Adam Silver on James Dolan, Scott Perry, Steve Mills, Mark Jackson, Apr 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Troy Williams on Scott Perry
item.description:
“And plus they're a young team. Scott Perry has done a good job. You know Troy's game, he'll bring energy and athleticism.”

Troy Williams on Scott Perry, Feb 20, 2018. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Moe Harkless on Scott Perry
item.description:
“(Scott Perry and I) had a really good relationship. We still have a good relationship. We actually spoke not too long ago. We talk all the time,”

Moe Harkless on Scott Perry, Aug 12, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Steve Mills on Scott Perry
item.description:
Tommy Beer:Mills:

“I’m going to give Scott (Perry) the room to make basketball decisionsand allow him to make recommendations to me.”

Steve Mills on Scott Perry, Jul 17, 2017. Source: Twitter @TommyBeer.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Scott Perry, Rob Hennigan
item.description:
Aaron Gordon:

“It’s just exciting to me. I’ve always trusted Rob Hennigan and I’ve always trusted Scott Perry. To me, it validates my trust in them. They made moves that other people couldn’t have made. They were confident, aggressive moves. Now, it’s on us. We’re ready to play. We have the coach, the staff, the players, the organization. We have a foundation of players who have been there and been through the losing, and now it’s time to start winning.”

Aaron Gordon on Scott Perry, Rob Hennigan, Sep 6, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.
